marketing_description: The Milwaukee® 7 in. Tile Diamond Blade (49-93-9207) features durable steel construction with a diamond cutting edge and Diamond Max Technology for cutting ceramic tile, porcelain tile, marble, and granite. Built with a continuous rim and a thin 0.055 in. profile, this blade operates at up to 13,300 RPM with a 5/8 in. arbor size and a 1-1/8 in. cut width. Suitable for both dry and wet applications, this red blade is compatible with Milwaukee® angle grinders and tile saws.
